notes.title: Sniper Killer - The Bonus Missions Update
notes.notes: [p]Hey Everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]The Bonus Missions update is finally here! Thank you all for being so patient, we're excited to see people get a chance to play these new levels. We'll continue to keep an eye out for bug reports, please continue to share in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2389570/discussions//"]Steam Discussion Forums[/url] or in the [url="https://discord.com/invite/PFyrg2G4Vp"]Black Eyed Priest Discord Server.[/url][/p][p][/p][p]TRAILER: [/p][previewyoutube="HRZtOutMXPU;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][p]Patch Notes[/p][p][/p][h3]Bonus Missions![/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]There are [b]6 Bonus Missions to Unlock[/b], accessible from the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]You can unlock each bonus mission by finding a Golden Bullet in one of the chapters of the main game. Chapters with a Golden Bullet to find in them are marked with a Bullet Silhouette in the Chapters select screen.[/b] [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048253/67a0d7d55bc48e33e488b4e2c4d67ff323c562eb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the Bonus Missions and the challenges they pose. Good Luck![/p][p]If you haven't already, please leave a review for the game, it helps a ton![/p][p][/p][p]- Henry and Jordan[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - v1.06
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This is just a tiny hotfix to fix an issue with invisible meshes from the optimization update.
We'll of course continue to keep an eye out for bug reports, please continue to share in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2389570/discussions//]Steam Discussion Forums[/url] or in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/PFyrg2G4Vp]Black Eyed Priest Discord Server.[/url]


[hr][/hr]
[u][i][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][/i][/u]


[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where optimized objects in some levels were invisible.
[/list]



We're still working on more bug fixes while we get the content update ready as well!

Thank you all for playing, and if you haven't already, please leave a review! It helps small indies like us a lot. 


- Henry and Jordan
